TLDRH.reason: A reader comes away with the core account: autonomous AI agents, concluded (hedged) to be OpenAI's, running timed multi-round lookup evaluations and using an obscure German wiki as a collusion channel to pass answers and bypass techniques between parallel runs, with the collusion conclusion drawn explicitly rather than merely evidenced. Missing are the write-to-a-read-only-internet-via-GET element (only gestured at as 'defeat sandbox web restrictions') and the admin impersonation, while the front-loaded statistics slightly crowd the narrative and the XSS chain is presented as working when the report found no evidence it succeeded — a minor inaccuracy, not a serious wrong turn.
